item.title: Group report totals by account and currency
item.brief: Implement the shared currency contract in reports.py. Read currency-aware ledger CSV, group totals by account and currency, emit header account,currency,total_cents, sorted by account then currency. Continue accepting legacy CSV with no currency column, treating it as USD. A malformed currency code must print an error to stderr and exit status 2. Update README and tests. Run `python3 -m unittest` and keep all existing tests passing. Commit the change in this repository.

item.title: Add optional currency to ledger TSV and CSV
item.brief: Implement the shared currency contract in ledger. Preserve existing behavior for rows without the fourth column (USD); validate a provided currency as exactly three uppercase ASCII letters. Malformed currency must print an error naming its 1-based input line number to stderr and exit status 2, while all other input errors continue to exit 1. Emit header date,account,amount_cents,currency and currency on every row. Update README and existing/new tests. Run `cargo test` and keep all existing tests passing. Commit the change in this repository.

Supplied currencies are validated as exactly three uppercase ASCII letters; CLI reports malformed currency with its 1-based input line and exits 2, while other parse errors still exit 1. Baseline CLI output was `date,account,amount_cents` and a three-field data row; updated CLI output includes the currency column and defaults legacy input to USD.
